sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned HCGP for respondent No.1.
Respondent No.2, who is NC: 2024:KHC:51322 served in the matter has remained unrepresented before this Court.

3. FIR in Crime No.24/2024 was registered by Viveknagar Police Station, Bengaluru, against Munna Suravra and others on the basis of the first information dated 04.02.2024 received from respondent No.2, who is the Inspector of Police attached to Viveknagar Police Station, Bengaluru.
During the course of investigation of the case, petitioners herein, who are arraigned as accused Nos.1 and 3 in the FIR were arrested on 04.02.2024 and remanded to judicial custody.
Bail application filed by them before the jurisdictional Sessions Court in Crl.Misc.No.4779/2024 was rejected on 29.06.2024.
Therefore, they are before this Court.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners herein are the husband and wife.
They are in custody for the last more than 10 months.
Victims have already been examined before the Trial Court.
Accused Nos.4 and 5 have been granted regular bail by the Trial Court in the present case.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.

6. In the first information dated 04.02.2024, it is averred that on 04.02.2024, first informant had received credible information about illegal business of prostitution within the jurisdiction of Viveknagar Police Station, Bengaluru and on receipt of such information, raid was conducted to the alleged premises in which illegal business of prostitution was being conducted and CWs 2 and 3,
who are the alleged victims in the present case were rescued and accused Nos.1 to 5 were apprehended from the premises and remanded to judicial custody.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed against five accused persons and petitioners herein, who are husband and wife
are arraigned as accused Nos.1 and 3 in the charge sheet.

Allegation against accused persons in the charge sheet is that they were inducing victim girls of providing employment in beauty parlours at Bengaluru and thereafter, victim girls were forced into business of prostitution.
CWs 2 and 3 are the victims in the present case, who are said to be from Bangladesh.
The said victims have already been examined before the Trial Court as PWs 1 and 2.
Therefore, there cannot be any apprehension that NC: 2024:KHC:51322 petitioners herein are likely to tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
Accused Nos.4 and 5 have been granted regular bail by the Trial Court.
Prosecution in all has cited 23 charge sheet witnesses in the present case and out of them, only two witnesses have been examined.
Therefore, the chances of trial being completed in the near soon is very remote.

Considering the nature of allegations found against petitioners in the charge sheet and also having regard to the period of their incarceration, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by them for grant of regular bail needs to be answered affirmatively more so the victim girls have been examined before the Trial Court.
Therefore, the following order:-
7. The petition is allowed.

The petitioners are directed to be enlarged on bail in Special Case No.760/2024 pending before the Court of Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge, FTSC IV,
Bengaluru, arising out of Crime No.24/2024 registered by Viveknagar Police Station, Bengaluru, for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 109, 370 and 370(A) of IPC, Sections 5(L), 6 and 17 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Sections 3, 4, 5, 7(1), 7(1)(A) of NC:
2024:KHC:51322 Immoral Traffic Prevention Act, 1956, subject to the following conditions:
a) Petitioners shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- each with two sureties, out of which one shall be a local surety, for the likesum, to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court;
b) The petitioners shall appear regularly on all the dates of hearing before the Trial Court unless the Trial Court exempts their appearance for valid reasons;
